topic.title: Low-Rank Adaptation and Memory-Efficient Model Training
topic.area: Language Models and Natural Language Processing
topic.overview: Large models can be expensive to adapt because training stores gradients and optimizer state as well as parameters. This topic explores low-rank updates, gradient projection, selective layer training, and low-rank compression. These methods save different resources: some restrict trainable directions, while others change which layers or singular components receive computation.
topic.whyItMatters: Efficiency claims need to be assessed alongside the expressive capacity retained by the update. A small adaptation budget may work well for one task but prevent changes required by another, making rank allocation and parameter selection substantive modeling decisions.
topic.evolution: The representatives include early adapters and structured compression, followed by layer sampling and projected-gradient training. Recent papers analyze differences from full fine-tuning, improve low-rank update scaling, and allocate compression ranks according to estimated loss sensitivity across a model.
openQuestions: How can a training procedure identify which layers and ranks a new task needs?
When do memory savings translate into lower end-to-end time and energy?

papers.title: Compacter: Efficient Low-Rank Hypercomplex Adapter Layers
papers.tldr: Compacter uses compact structured adapters to match or exceed standard fine-tuning in reported evaluations while training just 0.047% of model parameters.

papers.title: DRONE: Data-aware Low-rank Compression for Large NLP Models
papers.tldr: DRONE compresses BERT using low-dimensional structure in layer representations, improving model size and inference speed with limited accuracy loss.

papers.title: NxMTransformer: Semi-Structured Sparsification for Natural Language Understanding via ADMM
papers.tldr: NxMTransformer uses ADMM to impose hardware-compatible sparsity on pretrained language models, improving reported GLUE performance over existing sparsification practices.

papers.title: Sparse Structure Search for Delta Tuning
papers.tldr: S³Delta automatically searches adaptation-module structures, retaining over 99% of reported fine-tuning performance with 0.01% trainable parameters.

papers.title: LoSparse: Structured Compression of Large Language Models based on Low-Rank and Sparse Approximation
papers.tldr: LoSparse compresses transformer weights with complementary low-rank and sparse components, outperforming existing compression methods in the reported language-task evaluations.

papers.title: Composing Parameter-Efficient Modules with Arithmetic Operation
papers.tldr: Linear arithmetic on lightweight adaptation modules produces useful combined language-model capabilities without additional training.

papers.title: Make Pre-trained Model Reversible: From Parameter to Memory Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: MEFT adds adapters that preserve a pretrained model's starting point while enabling reversible computation and substantially lower activation memory.

papers.title: Mix-of-Show: Decentralized Low-Rank Adaptation for Multi-Concept Customization of Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Mix-of-Show combines separately trained concept adaptations and regional sampling controls to generate multiple customized concepts with high fidelity.

papers.title: Res-Tuning: A Flexible and Efficient Tuning Paradigm via Unbinding Tuner from Backbone
papers.tldr: Res-Tuning separates adaptation modules from the backbone, enabling flexible tuning combinations and a memory-efficient variant with shared backbone computation.

papers.title: Asymmetry in Low-Rank Adapters of Foundation Models
papers.tldr: LoRA’s two matrices play unequal roles, and training only the output-facing matrix can preserve performance while improving a generalization bound.

papers.title: Compressible Dynamics in Deep Overparameterized Low-Rank Learning & Adaptation
papers.tldr: Compressing low-dimensional training dynamics preserves overparameterization benefits in matrix learning and motivates Deep LoRA for less overfitting in language-model adaptation.

papers.title: DoRA: Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.tldr: DoRA adapts weight magnitude and direction separately, improving on LoRA in reported experiments without additional inference overhead.

papers.title: ETHER: Efficient Finetuning of Large-Scale Models with Hyperplane Reflections
papers.tldr: ETHER uses hyperplane reflections for robust fine-tuning, matching or outperforming tested alternatives with roughly 10–100 times fewer parameters than LoRA or OFT.

papers.title: Flora: Low-Rank Adapters Are Secretly Gradient Compressors
papers.tldr: Flora resamples gradient projections to enable high-rank model updates while retaining sublinear memory use for optimization states.

papers.title: GaLore: Memory-Efficient LLM Training by Gradient Low-Rank Projection
papers.tldr: GaLore projects gradients into low-rank form to reduce training memory while retaining full-parameter learning, enabling demonstrated 7B pretraining on 24GB consumer GPUs.

papers.title: LoRA+: Efficient Low Rank Adaptation of Large Models
papers.tldr: LoRA+ assigns different learning rates to its two adapter matrices, improving finetuning speed and performance at the same computational cost.

papers.title: LoRA Training in the NTK Regime has No Spurious Local Minima
papers.tldr: In the NTK regime, LoRA with sufficiently large rank has no spurious local minima and finds low-rank solutions that generalize well.

papers.title: LoRAP: Transformer Sub-Layers Deserve Differentiated Structured Compression for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: LoRAP combines low-rank attention compression with feed-forward channel pruning, exploiting differences between transformer sublayers.

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Controls
papers.tldr: Viewing LoRA as a control system motivates parameter-free attention inside adapters, improving performance across the evaluated datasets and ranks.

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Discrete Fourier Transform
papers.tldr: FourierFT learns a small subset of Fourier coefficients to represent weight updates, matching or beating LoRA with fewer trainable parameters in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Parameter Efficient Quasi-Orthogonal Fine-Tuning via Givens Rotation
papers.tldr: qGOFT combines a parameter-efficient Givens-rotation construction with soft orthogonality constraints to make pretrained-model adaptation more flexible.

papers.title: Recovering the Pre-Fine-Tuning Weights of Generative Models
papers.tldr: Spectral DeTuning can recover pre-fine-tuning model weights from a few LoRA-fine-tuned models, challenging an assumption about alignment protection.

papers.title: Riemannian Preconditioned LoRA for Fine-Tuning Foundation Models
papers.tldr: A small geometrically derived preconditioner improves LoRA optimization, with theoretical stabilization and empirical gains in convergence and hyperparameter robustness.

papers.title: RoSA: Accurate Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Robust Adaptation
papers.tldr: RoSA combines low-rank and sparse updates to improve parameter-efficient fine-tuning, matching full fine-tuning on some evaluated tasks.

papers.title: SPP: Sparsity-Preserved Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: SPP improves pruned language models through lightweight fine-tuning that preserves their sparsity pattern and ratio during training and merging.

papers.title: Bridging The Gap between Low-rank and Orthogonal Adaptation via Householder Reflection Adaptation
papers.tldr: Householder reflection adaptation links orthogonal and adaptive low-rank fine-tuning, with reported gains using fewer trainable parameters.

papers.title: Compressing Large Language Models using Low Rank and Low Precision Decomposition
papers.tldr: CALDERA combines quantization with low-rank decomposition to improve tested language models' performance under compression below 2.5 bits per parameter.

papers.title: CorDA: Context-Oriented Decomposition Adaptation of Large Language Models for Task-Aware Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning
papers.tldr: CorDA uses representative data to construct task-aware adapters that can prioritize preserving knowledge or improving performance on a new task.

papers.title: DISP-LLM: Dimension-Independent Structural Pruning for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: DISP-LLM makes structural pruning more flexible by letting language-model blocks retain different features and use different input and output widths.

papers.title: DropBP: Accelerating Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models by Dropping Backward Propagation
papers.tldr: DropBP selectively skips layers during backpropagation to reduce fine-tuning computation and activation memory while maintaining comparable accuracy in reported experiments.

papers.title: Expanding Sparse Tuning for Low Memory Usage
papers.tldr: SNELL combines compact low-rank parameters, nonlinear kernels, and competition-based sparsification to deliver strong sparse fine-tuning performance with low memory usage.

papers.title: FLoRA: Federated Fine-Tuning Large Language Models with Heterogeneous Low-Rank Adaptations
papers.tldr: FLoRA uses stacking-based aggregation to combine heterogeneous LoRA adapters without the aggregation noise identified in earlier federated fine-tuning methods.

papers.title: Group and Shuffle: Efficient Structured Orthogonal Parametrization
papers.tldr: A generalized structured-matrix construction makes orthogonal fine-tuning more parameter-efficient and extends to orthogonal convolutions.

papers.title: LISA: Layerwise Importance Sampling for Memory-Efficient Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: LISA reduces fine-tuning memory by sampling layer updates and freezing most middle layers, with strong reported performance relative to LoRA.

papers.title: LoRA-GA: Low-Rank Adaptation with Gradient Approximation
papers.tldr: LoRA-GA accelerates low-rank fine-tuning by initializing its updates to approximate the initial gradient of full fine-tuning.

papers.title: Memory-Efficient LLM Training with Online Subspace Descent
papers.tldr: Online Subspace Descent updates training subspaces with online PCA, backed by convergence analysis and improved low-rank language-model training results.

papers.title: PiSSA: Principal Singular Values and Singular Vectors Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.tldr: PiSSA trains the principal components of pretrained weights through low-rank adapters, improving convergence and performance over LoRA in reported experiments.

papers.title: S$^{2}$FT: Efficient, Scalable and Generalizable LLM Fine-tuning by Structured Sparsity
papers.tldr: S²FT updates selected heads and channels as dense parameter blocks, reporting improved fine-tuning performance, efficiency, and support for scalable serving.

papers.title: SLTrain: a sparse plus low rank approach for parameter and memory efficient pretraining
papers.tldr: SLTrain combines low-rank weights with a fixed sparse component to make language-model pretraining more parameter- and memory-efficient.

papers.title: Sparse High Rank Adapters
papers.tldr: SHiRA tunes sparse subsets of model weights to enable fast fused-adapter switching and reduce concept loss when adapters are combined.

papers.title: Spectral Adapter: Fine-Tuning in Spectral Space
papers.tldr: Spectral Adapter uses pretrained weights’ top singular directions to improve adapter rank capacity, parameter efficiency, and fine-tuning performance.

papers.title: Structured Unrestricted-Rank Matrices for Parameter Efficient Finetuning
papers.tldr: Structured unrestricted-rank matrices offer a compact alternative to low-rank fine-tuning updates, with reported accuracy gains and substantial adapter parameter savings.

papers.title: SVFT: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Singular Vectors
papers.tldr: SVFT learns sparse combinations of a model's singular vectors, recovering up to 96% of full fine-tuning performance with few trainable parameters.

papers.title: $\textit{Trans-LoRA}$: towards data-free Transferable Parameter Efficient Finetuning
papers.tldr: Trans-LoRA uses synthetic data derived from an observed task subset to transfer adapters across models with no reported performance loss in its evaluations.

papers.title: The Impact of Initialization on LoRA Finetuning Dynamics
papers.tldr: LoRA's two zero-product initialization choices learn differently, with zero B and random A performing better on average in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Unveiling LoRA Intrinsic Ranks via Salience Analysis
papers.tldr: SalientLoRA uses singular-value histories and adaptive measurement windows to allocate LoRA ranks more effectively and efficiently.

papers.title: VB-LoRA: Extreme Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning with Vector Banks
papers.tldr: VB-LoRA constructs adaptation matrices from a shared vector bank, sharply reducing stored parameters while maintaining strong evaluated performance.

papers.title: VeLoRA: Memory Efficient Training using Rank-1 Sub-Token Projections
papers.tldr: VeLoRA saves training memory by storing one-dimensional projections of activation segments and reconstructing them coarsely for backpropagation.

papers.title: A Memory Efficient Randomized Subspace Optimization Method for Training Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Randomized Subspace Optimization reduces activation and optimizer-state memory while matching GaLore and Adam performance in reported experiments.

papers.title: A Stronger Mixture of Low-Rank Experts for Fine-Tuning Foundation Models
papers.tldr: Gate-rescaled projections improve the stability and feature learning of mixtures of low-rank adapters.

papers.title: Beyond Zero Initialization: Investigating the Impact of Non-Zero Initialization on LoRA Fine-Tuning Dynamics
papers.tldr: Initializing both LoRA matrices to nonzero values can improve robustness to suboptimal learning rates without generally harming fine-tuning performance.

papers.title: BSLoRA: Enhancing the Parameter Efficiency of LoRA with Intra-Layer and Inter-Layer Sharing
papers.tldr: BSLoRA shares adaptation parameters within and across LoRA components, using 44.59% of standard LoRA's parameters while improving reported benchmark performance.

papers.title: Come Together, But Not Right Now: A Progressive Strategy to Boost Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.tldr: CoTo gradually activates LoRA adapters during training, improving task performance, merging, and pruning while reducing training overhead.

papers.title: Compress then Serve: Serving Thousands of LoRA Adapters with Little Overhead

papers.title: Delta Decompression for MoE-based LLMs Compression
papers.tldr: D²-MoE compresses shared expert weights and individual differences without additional training, outperforming other compressors in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: Flat-LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation over a Flat Loss Landscape
papers.tldr: Flat-LoRA seeks low-rank updates in flat regions of the full parameter space, improving generalization across the evaluated tasks.

papers.title: From Low Rank Gradient Subspace Stabilization to Low-Rank Weights: Observations, Theories, and Applications
papers.tldr: WeLore uses uneven low-rank structure across language-model weights to combine compression with selective, resource-efficient fine-tuning.

papers.title: FRUGAL: Memory-Efficient Optimization by Reducing State Overhead for Scalable Training
papers.tldr: FRUGAL saves optimizer memory by using stateful optimization in selected directions and state-free updates elsewhere, preserving full-rank weight updates.

papers.title: KIND: Knowledge Integration and Diversion for Training Decomposable Models
papers.tldr: KIND pretrains decomposable models whose shared and class-specific components can be recombined for deployment and more selective transfer.

papers.title: LIFT the Veil for the Truth: Principal Weights Emerge after Rank Reduction for Reasoning-Focused Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: LIFT uses low-rank approximation to select the 5% of weights it updates, improving reasoning and knowledge retention in reported evaluations.

papers.title: LoRA-One: One-Step Full Gradient Could Suffice for Fine-Tuning Large Language Models, Provably and Efficiently

papers.title: LoRA Training Provably Converges to a Low-Rank Global Minimum Or It Fails Loudly (But it Probably Won’t Fail)
papers.tldr: The analysis separates favorable LoRA convergence from a structurally distinct alternative and argues that common training choices favor global minima.

papers.title: Low-Rank Adapting Models for Sparse Autoencoders
papers.tldr: Fine-tuning language models around existing sparse autoencoders reduces insertion-related prediction loss and reaches matched loss faster than end-to-end SAE training.

papers.title: Make LoRA Great Again: Boosting LoRA with Adaptive Singular Values and Mixture-of-Experts Optimization Alignment
papers.tldr: GOAT combines adaptive SVD-based experts with theoretically motivated scaling to improve LoRA and close its performance gap with full fine-tuning.

papers.title: MoE-SVD: Structured Mixture-of-Experts LLMs Compression via Singular Value Decomposition
papers.tldr: MoE-SVD selectively decomposes and shares expert matrices to compress mixture-of-experts models without extra training and with minimal reported performance loss.

papers.title: Neutral residues: revisiting adapters for model extension
papers.tldr: Neutral residues add adapters that are nearly inactive on the original domain, improving new-language learning while preserving English performance.

papers.title: Olica: Efficient Structured Pruning of Large Language Models without Retraining
papers.tldr: Olica prunes language models without retraining by compressing attention matrix products and directly calibrating feed-forward errors.

papers.title: On the Duality between Gradient Transformations and Adapters

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of State Space Models

papers.title: Pivoting Factorization: A Compact Meta Low-Rank Representation of Sparsity for Efficient Inference in Large Language Models
papers.tldr: MPIFA combines lossless compaction of low-rank representations with retraining-free reconstruction to improve compressed language-model efficiency and quality.

papers.title: RepLoRA: Reparameterizing Low-rank Adaptation via the Perspective of Mixture of Experts
papers.tldr: RepLoRA reparameterizes low-rank adaptation matrices with a lightweight network, translating a theoretical sample-efficiency insight into empirical gains.

papers.title: SeedLoRA: A Fusion Approach to Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: SeedLoRA fuses same-task LoRA models trained with different random seeds to improve performance and narrow the gap to full fine-tuning.

papers.title: SEMU: Singular Value Decomposition for Efficient Machine Unlearning
papers.tldr: SEMU uses an SVD-based low-dimensional projection to perform competitive unlearning with fewer changed parameters and no original training data.

papers.title: Sketch to Adapt: Fine-Tunable Sketches for Efficient LLM Adaptation
papers.tldr: SketchTune jointly compresses and adapts language-model weights through trainable sketches, improving efficiency and benchmark performance without low-rank adapters.

papers.title: Sparse Spectral Training and Inference on Euclidean and Hyperbolic Neural Networks
papers.tldr: SST updates all singular values and selected singular vectors to reduce training memory while approaching full-rank performance in reported settings.

papers.title: SparseLoRA: Accelerating LLM Fine-Tuning with Contextual Sparsity
papers.tldr: SparseLoRA dynamically limits fine-tuning computation to selected weights, achieving measured speedups of up to 1.6 times while maintaining accuracy.

papers.title: Subspace Optimization for Large Language Models with Convergence Guarantees
papers.tldr: GoLore uses random low-rank gradient projection to provide stochastic convergence guarantees after identifying cases where GaLore fails.

papers.title: Targeted Low-rank Refinement: Enhancing Sparse Language Models with Precision
papers.tldr: Iterative low-rank corrections recover information lost during language-model pruning and improve sparse-model performance.

papers.tldr: WeGeFT generates adaptation weights from pretrained weights, combining several forms of efficiency while matching or exceeding LoRA-family performance.

papers.tldr: 3BASiL-TM combines layer reconstruction and transformer-level refinement to compress language models more quickly while better preserving prediction quality.

papers.title: Accurate and Efficient Low-Rank Model Merging in Core Space
papers.tldr: Core Space merges low-rank model adaptations in a shared compact representation, improving measured accuracy while reducing computation.

papers.title: Activated LoRA: Fine-tuned LLMs for Intrinsics
papers.tldr: Activated LoRA applies adaptation only after invocation, allowing specialized models to reuse the base model’s conversation cache.

papers.title: AdaMSS: Adaptive Multi-Subspace Approach for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: AdaMSS adaptively concentrates fine-tuning in task-relevant subspaces, reporting strong performance with substantially fewer trainable parameters.

papers.tldr: AlphaDecay improves tested language-model pretraining by assigning weight decay separately according to each module’s spectral properties.

papers.title: AltLoRA: Towards Better Gradient Approximation in Low-Rank Adaptation with Alternating Projections
papers.tldr: AltLoRA uses alternating projections to improve low-rank adaptation and incorporate momentum while preserving memory efficiency.

papers.tldr: TopLoRA improves low-rank adaptation by adjusting its projection for each token without increasing the adaptation rank.

papers.title: Bilevel ZOFO: Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning and Meta-Training
papers.tldr: Bilevel-ZOFO couples gradient-trained adapters with forward-pass optimization of the full model to improve fine-tuning efficiency and performance.

papers.title: Breaking the Frozen Subspace: Importance Sampling for Low-Rank Optimization in LLM Pretraining
papers.tldr: Importance sampling improves low-rank language-model pretraining by addressing stagnant update subspaces and providing a convergence guarantee.

papers.title: C-LoRA: Contextual Low-Rank Adaptation for Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
papers.tldr: C-LoRA makes parameter-efficient fine-tuning sensitive to individual inputs, improving uncertainty estimates and generalization in experiments with 7B models.

papers.tldr: Rotor-based linear layers use compact geometric compositions and match strong approximation baselines in language-model attention projections.

papers.tldr: CrossSpectra compresses fine-tuning updates across transformer layers using sparse spectral representations, matching or improving baseline performance with far fewer parameters.

papers.title: DenoiseRotator: Enhance Pruning Robustness for LLMs via Importance Concentration
papers.tldr: DenoiseRotator concentrates weight importance before pruning, reducing performance loss across several language models and pruning methods.

papers.title: Drag-and-Drop LLMs: Zero-Shot Prompt-to-Weights

papers.tldr: F-Adapter allocates adaptation capacity by frequency, improving physical-system modeling over LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods on 3D Navier–Stokes benchmarks.

papers.title: FedSVD: Adaptive Orthogonalization for Private Federated Learning with LoRA
papers.tldr: FedSVD refreshes LoRA factors through server-side SVD to reduce privacy-noise amplification while retaining adaptive update directions.

papers.title: Fira: Can We Achieve Full-rank Training of LLMs Under Low-rank Constraint?
papers.tldr: Fira uses low-rank optimizer scaling to support full-rank training with reduced optimizer-state memory.

papers.title: FlyLoRA: Boosting Task Decoupling and Parameter Efficiency via Implicit Rank-Wise Mixture-of-Experts
papers.tldr: FlyLoRA combines sparse random projections with implicit expert routing to reduce parameter interference and improve adaptation across four evaluated domains.

papers.tldr: GaRA-SAM uses input-dependent gated adapters to improve segmentation robustness, gaining up to 21.3 IoU percentage points on ACDC.

papers.tldr: GraLoRA assigns separate low-rank adapters to weight sub-blocks, improving fine-tuning performance by addressing gradient entanglement in standard LoRA.

papers.tldr: DiZO adapts zeroth-order updates by layer, improving reported fine-tuning accuracy and reducing training GPU hours by up to 48%.

papers.title: Hyperbolic Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: HypLoRA adapts language models directly in hyperbolic space, preserving geometric effects and improving tested reasoning performance.

papers.title: LaX: Boosting Low-Rank Training of Foundation Models via Latent Crossing
papers.tldr: LaX connects low-rank subspaces, helping tested models match or exceed full-rank performance with fewer parameters and improving LoRA fine-tuning.

papers.title: Linearization Explains Fine-Tuning in Large Language Models
papers.tldr: A regularized linearization analysis connects fine-tuning performance to neural tangent kernel spectra when the linear approximation is appropriate.

papers.title: Loquetier: A Virtualized Multi-LoRA Framework for Unified LLM Fine-tuning and Serving
papers.tldr: Loquetier shares a base model across LoRA adapters and merges computation paths to improve unified fine-tuning and inference.

papers.tldr: LoRA and full fine-tuning produce different weight structures, with LoRA's intruder dimensions causally linked to forgetting in the reported experiments.

papers.title: LoRASuite: Efficient LoRA Adaptation Across Large Language Model Upgrades

papers.title: Merging on the Fly Without Retraining: A Sequential Approach to Scalable Continual Model Merging
papers.tldr: Orthogonal projections and adaptive scaling merge models sequentially without retraining or memory growth proportional to the number of models.

papers.title: MISA: Memory-Efficient LLMs Optimization with Module-wise Importance Sampling
papers.tldr: MISA samples important sub-layer modules for updates, reducing training memory and gradient variance with a stated stochastic convergence guarantee.

papers.tldr: LoPE trains a dedicated noise-processing LoRA expert and masks it at inference to improve robustness without data cleaning.

papers.title: Parameter Efficient Fine-tuning via Explained Variance Adaptation
papers.tldr: EVA initializes and allocates LoRA directions using activation variance, improving fine-tuning speed, accuracy, and parameter efficiency.

papers.tldr: U-LoRA uses token-specific gates and sequence context to adaptively use an existing low-rank update space, achieving competitive performance at comparable parameter budgets.

papers.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
papers.tldr: LEMS and KFAC-SVD improve language-model compression by refining layer-wise rank allocation and low-rank decomposition quality.

papers.title: Balanced LoRA: Removing Parameter Invariance to Accelerate Convergence
papers.tldr: BaLoRA balances equivalent low-rank factors to improve optimization conditioning and empirically accelerate fine-tuning.

papers.title: Bayesian-LoRA: Probabilistic Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Bayesian-LoRA makes low-rank adaptation probabilistic, improving confidence calibration while maintaining competitive accuracy with modest added training cost.

papers.title: Can Muon Fine-tune Adam-Pretrained Models?
papers.tldr: LoRA reduces the performance penalty from switching Adam-pretrained models to Muon fine-tuning by constraining adaptation updates.

papers.title: CGSVD: Cascaded Granular Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
papers.tldr: CGSVD compresses language models without retraining by allocating low-rank capacity according to layer importance and component compressibility.

papers.title: COBRA: Contribution-Based Bayesian Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: COBRA allocates fine-tuning capacity using both layer contribution and adaptation demand, improving results under comparable parameter budgets.

papers.title: Compress then Merge: From Multiple LoRAs into One Low-Rank Adapter
papers.tldr: Compress-then-Merge combines LoRA adapters inside shared low-dimensional subspaces, preserving the rank constraint and improving reported single-adapter performance.

papers.title: CSPLoRA: Confidence-Guided Structural Planning for Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.tldr: CSPLoRA uses uncertain examples to plan reusable LoRA rank allocations that improve average performance with comparable parameter counts.

papers.title: CurvZO: Adaptive Curvature-Guided Sparse Zeroth-Order Optimization for Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: CurvZO uses online curvature signals to choose and adapt sparse forward-only updates, improving fine-tuning speed and accuracy while preserving memory efficiency.

papers.title: Decentralized Instruction Tuning: Conflict-Aware Splitting and Weight Merging
papers.tldr: MERIT partitions instruction data by gradient conflict, trains independently, and merges once to improve evaluated performance while avoiding inter-partition training communication.

papers.title: Decomposing the Basic Abilities of Large Language Models: Mitigating Cross-Task Interference in Multi-Task Instruct-Tuning
papers.tldr: BADIT organizes instruction-tuning updates into orthogonal LoRA experts motivated by reusable abilities, reducing cross-task interference in experiments with six language models.

papers.title: Diffract: Spectral View of LLM Domain Adaptation
papers.tldr: Spectral analysis finds that domain adaptation mainly changes weight directions, with many attention-head updates removable without measurable quality loss.

papers.title: Disentangling Geometry, Performance, and Training in Language Models
papers.tldr: Across 108 controlled language-model variants, existing geometric metrics reflect training choices more reliably than downstream performance.

papers.title: Distilling Linearized Behavior into Non-linear Fine-Tuning for Effective Task Arithmetic
papers.tldr: Distilling a linearized teacher's hidden representations gives nonlinear models effective task arithmetic without additional inference-time overhead.

papers.title: Don’t Reinvent the Wheel, Just Realign the Spokes: Resource-Efficient Federated Fine-Tuning via Rank-Wise Expert Assembly
papers.tldr: SmartFed reassembles fine-grained experts from existing LoRA modules to improve federated fine-tuning performance and efficiency.

papers.title: Effective MoE-based LLM Compression by Exploiting Heterogeneous Inter-Group Experts Routing Frequency and Information Density
papers.tldr: RFID-MoE improves expert-model compression by allocating capacity according to expert usage and information density while recovering residual information.

papers.title: Enhancing LLM Training via Spectral Clipping
papers.tldr: SPECTRA improves language-model pretraining by clipping the spectral structure of optimizer updates and, optionally, noisy gradients.

papers.title: Escaping the Subspace Trap: The Role of Optimizer Geometry in Model Width Expansion
papers.tldr: The paper shows how optimizer geometry can free width-expanded models from an initialization-aligned subspace and activate their added capacity.

papers.title: Extra-Merge: Tracing the Rank-1 Subspace of Model Merging in Language Model Pre-Training
papers.tldr: Extra-Merge extrapolates along a stable direction revealed by checkpoint averaging to improve language models without additional gradient updates.

papers.title: Federated Sketching LoRA: A Flexible Framework for Heterogeneous Collaborative Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.tldr: FSLoRA lets clients update differently sized portions of shared LoRA modules to accommodate unequal resources in federated fine-tuning.

papers.title: FedRot-LoRA: Mitigating Rotational Misalignment in Federated LoRA
papers.tldr: FedRot-LoRA aligns the internal orientations of client updates before averaging, reducing aggregation error without extra communication.

papers.title: Fine-Tuning of Transformer models with Frames
papers.tldr: FrameFT expresses weight updates with sparse coefficients in shared, algorithmically generated bases to reduce fine-tuning memory and computation.

papers.title: FlexRank: Nested Low-Rank Knowledge Decomposition for Adaptive Model Deployment
papers.tldr: FlexRank decomposes pretrained models into nested components that can be selectively activated to fit different computational budgets.

papers.title: FOAM: Blocked State Folding for Memory-Efficient LLM Training
papers.tldr: FOAM compresses optimizer states with block averages and residual correction, removing up to 90% of their memory overhead in experiments.

papers.title: Geometry-Preserving Orthonormal Initialization for Low-Rank Adaptation in RLVR
papers.tldr: Orthonormal initialization brings LoRA closer to full fine-tuning in the paper’s analysis and improves stability and mathematical reasoning under RLVR.

papers.title: GIST: Targeted Data Selection for Instruction Tuning via Coupled Optimization Geometry
papers.tldr: GIST selects instruction-tuning data through task-specific gradient subspaces, matching or improving reported performance with far less storage and computation.

papers.title: GR-LoRA: Gradient-Recycling Low-Rank Adaptation for Class-Incremental Learning
papers.tldr: GR-LoRA recycles otherwise discarded gradient components into lightweight modules to balance new-class learning with retention.

papers.title: Heterogeneous Customizable Personalized Federated Fine-Tuning Approach for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Het-CPFLoRA customizes federated LoRA adaptation by separating shared and personal knowledge and adjusting their balance during inference.

papers.title: LAVA: A Unified Framework for Finetuning Language and Vision Models
papers.tldr: LAVA adapts language and vision models through learnable rank-one components, with orthogonal regularization to reduce gradient variance.

papers.title: Learning in the Fisher Subspace: A Guided Initialization for LoRA Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: The paper initializes LoRA using target-data Fisher information to select adaptation directions that better affect task-relevant predictions.

papers.title: Learning Rate Scaling across LoRA Ranks and Transfer to Full Finetuning
papers.tldr: Maximal-Update Adaptation derives configuration-dependent learning-rate scaling rules for LoRA and identifies a route to transferring rates to full fine-tuning.

papers.title: LoRA-DA: Data-Aware Initialization for Low-Rank Adaptation via Asymptotic Analysis
papers.tldr: LoRA-DA uses a data-aware bias–variance objective to initialize low-rank adaptation, improving accuracy and training stability with small overhead.

papers.title: Low-cost Full Fine-tuning: Learning What to Update for LLMs
papers.tldr: Think-Touch learns which parameter groups to update, offering conditional full-space convergence and lower reported memory costs than full fine-tuning.

papers.title: Low Kruskal-Rank Adaptation
papers.tldr: LoKRA uses Kruskal rank to address redundancy in parameter-efficient updates and reports improvements over LoRA across multiple language models.

papers.title: LOZO+: Provably Efficient Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning via Greedy Low-Rank Subspace Selection
papers.tldr: LOZO+ uses loss feedback to select productive low-rank update directions for memory-efficient language-model fine-tuning.

papers.title: Mitigating Error Propagation in Low-Rank Approximation of Large Models via Distribution-Aware Whitening
papers.tldr: Distribution-aware whitening reduces error propagation in low-rank compression by adapting to the changing inputs of successive layers.

papers.title: Muon in Associative Memory Learning: Training Dynamics and Scaling Laws
papers.tldr: In a structured associative-memory model, Muon balances learning across frequency components and achieves stronger convergence and scaling than gradient descent.

papers.title: NaRA: Noise-Aware LoRA for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Diffusion LLMs
papers.tldr: NaRA makes low-rank adaptations depend on diffusion noise level, improving reasoning and code generation with negligible reported overhead.

papers.title: On the Convergence Rate of LoRA Gradient Descent
papers.tldr: The paper proves an O(1/log T) stationary-point convergence rate for original LoRA gradient descent without strong boundedness assumptions.

papers.title: Orthogonal Model Merging
papers.tldr: OrthoMerge combines fine-tuned models through orthogonal geometry and residual merging, reducing reported forgetting across tasks.

papers.title: PLoRA: Efficient Concurrent LoRA Training for Large Language Models
papers.tldr: PLoRA coordinates concurrent adapter fine-tuning and efficient kernels, improving throughput by up to 12.8 times and shortening makespan by up to 7.52 times.

papers.title: POET-X: Memory-efficient LLM Training by Scaling Orthogonal Transformation
papers.tldr: POET-X reduces the overhead of orthogonal-transformation training, enabling billion-parameter language-model pretraining on one H100 in the reported experiments.

papers.title: PRAC: Principal-Random Subspace for LLM Activation Compression and Memory-Efficient Training
papers.tldr: PRAC combines principal and random activation subspaces to reduce training memory while preserving an unbiased gradient estimate.

papers.title: ProjQ: Project-and-Quantize for Adapter-Aware LLM Compression
papers.tldr: ProjQ shapes quantization errors into directions low-rank adapters can repair, preserving capacity for downstream learning.

papers.title: RaGEP: Rank-aware Geometric Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.tldr: RaGEP uses activation geometry to allocate expert budgets and remove redundant experts, reducing MoE size and inference cost while improving reported zero-shot results.

papers.title: SALAAD: Sparse And Low-Rank Adaptation via ADMM for Large Language Model Inference
papers.tldr: SALAAD learns sparse and low-rank structures during training, enabling flexible deployment across memory budgets from a single training run.

papers.title: ScaLoRA: Optimally Scaled Low-Rank Adaptation for Efficient High-Rank Fine-Tuning
papers.tldr: ScaLoRA analytically scales successive low-rank updates so their accumulation supports efficient high-rank adaptation and faster convergence.

papers.title: Sketch-Based Low-Rank Model Merging with Shared Circulant Transforms
papers.tldr: CircuMerge merges compact, aligned sketches of LoRA adapters, cutting merging time while maintaining or improving reported accuracy.

papers.title: SliceFine: The Universal Winning-Slice Hypothesis for Pretrained Networks
papers.tldr: SliceFine adapts pretrained models by updating small slices of existing weights, supported by a theory of spectral balance and retained task information.

papers.title: SSR-Merge: Subspace Signal Routing for Training-Free LoRA Merging in Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: SSR-Merge combines diffusion-model LoRAs through decorrelated signal routing, reducing interference with an Ordinary Least Squares foundation and streaming updates.

papers.title: Stabilizing Native Low-Rank LLM Pretraining
papers.tldr: Spectron stabilizes language-model pretraining with low-rank non-embedding weights by controlling the spectral size of weight updates.

papers.title: Swift-SVD: Theoretical Optimality Meets Practical Efficiency in Low-Rank LLM Compression
papers.tldr: Swift-SVD provides training-free, optimal layer-wise low-rank approximation and reports 3–70× faster end-to-end compression.

papers.title: The Appeal and Reality of Recycling LoRAs with Adaptive Merging
papers.tldr: Recycling repository LoRAs offers limited gains over training a fresh adapter in this study, although highly relevant modules can provide positive transfer.

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Dynamics of Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.tldr: The paper links LoRA dynamics to gradient projection and supports ETF initialization theoretically when gradients are unavailable and empirically across studied variants.

papers.title: Understanding MARS: When Scaling Momentum Correction Provably Helps
papers.tldr: Gamma-similarity explains when scaling MARS's momentum correction improves convergence, with language-model experiments supporting carefully chosen small scaling values.

papers.title: UnHype: CLIP-Guided Hypernetworks for Dynamic LoRA Unlearning
papers.tldr: UnHype generates LoRA weights from CLIP embeddings to support adaptive single- and multi-concept removal in image generators.

papers.title: Zero Sum SVD: Balancing Loss Sensitivity for Low Rank LLM Compression
papers.tldr: Zero Sum SVD allocates compression globally by balancing predicted loss changes across singular components.
